contract.oracle: GET /api/read/reservations until the reservation id is present
contract.pages: all declared pages are scanned; page plan grows if a response declares more pages
contract.over5000Definition: commit response received to first list visibility > 5000 ms; missing at 120000 ms is censored and counted over-or-missing
contract.percentileDefinition: nearest-rank p50/p95 over observed visible samples only; censored full-cohort percentiles not claimed
contract.rawReceiptPersistence: report rewritten synchronously after setup, every observation, and each completed sample
